svg.title: Checkout
svg.desc: 1. The client sends the cart with an idempotency key; a repeated key returns the first result instead of a second sale. 2. The server re-prices each line and option from the catalog and recomputes totals with the store's own tax settings. 3. A discount above 10% or above Rp 20.000 needs a reason and a PIN from someone allowed to approve it. 4. Non-cash payments may not exceed the bill, so no fee can be passed to the customer, and cash needs an open shift. 5. The sale, lines, payments, stock movements, store credit and kitchen ticket are written together and the kitchen screen is notified over server-sent events.
